Connect directly to Java servers without a multiplayer relay. Chrome desktop or ChromeOS 151+ is required.

1. Download the signed .swbn file.
2. Open the copied Chrome flags address. Enable both Enable Isolated Web Apps and Enable Isolated Web App Developer Mode, then restart Chrome.
3. Open the copied Web App Internals address in Chrome.
4. Under Developer Mode, find Install IWA from Signed Web Bundle, click Select file..., and choose the downloaded file.
5. Launch the app, open Multiplayer, and enter the server address.
6. Later, open chrome://apps/ and click Eaglercraft 26.2 to launch it again.
